name: Valoir Atelier
tagline: Architectural luxury eyewear theme tailored for bespoke optical boutiques and artisanal frame makers
description: Valoir Atelier is an editorial, high-craft Shopify theme built for boutique optical ateliers, luxury sunglass designers, and independent eyewear brands. Engineered with curated architectural silhouette navigation, bespoke craftsmanship storytelling, responsive bilingual English/Arabic RTL typography, and frictionless selling plan subscription capabilities.
features: Curated frame silhouette taxonomy and architectural geometry browsing for bespoke optical collections
Comprehensive Subscriptions and Selling Plans support for lens replenishment and frame care memberships
Native RTL support with bidirectional CSS logical properties for multi-region luxury commerce
WCAG AA compliance with accessible modal focus traps and high-contrast color hierarchy
Sticky add-to-cart bar and slide-out ajax bag with live shipping thresholds and prescription notes

setup_requirements.recommended_products: 8-16 high-resolution eyewear products with transparent PNG/WEBP cutout images and macro craftsmanship details
setup_requirements.recommended_collections: Optical Frames, Sun Protection, Limited Editions, Accessories & Care
setup_requirements.navigation_menus: Main menu with nested brand/collection links; footer menu with optical care, shipping, policies
